answer: Require every new submission to burn one scarce entry voucher minted from completed past work, forming a toll bridge that burst clone swarms cannot flood cheaply. Builders pledge 57 POA, record a ticket hash with spend proof through >=16 epochs, and verify peer audit records within 50 minutes near a grassy knoll. Reused tickets below <94% consensus suffer bond forfeit, sharp slash fees, and <2% pay. Each honest builder pledges 57 POA; acquiring 120 fake vouchers spends 6840 POA to gain 62 POA, a bad net loss washed down the river. Weakness: veterans may sell spare vouchers.
